confirmErase: This will erase ALL data on the ESP flash. Continue?
notepadHint: A plain-text copy of your code. Edit freely and save as .txt.
browserHint: Upload a sketch that starts a web server — the IP printed on the Serial Monitor appears here.
driversHint: USB serial devices on this PC. A device with a problem needs a driver.
tip1: Use a data USB cable — many cables only charge.
tip2: Install the USB-serial driver for your board chip (CH340, CP210x, FTDI).
tip3: ESP32: hold BOOT, press EN/RST, release BOOT, then upload.
tip4: Close other programs using the port (another IDE, Serial Monitor).
snapshotsOpt: Keep a snapshot of the sketch before each upload
welcomeText: Pick your language, theme and board packages. You can change all of this later in Settings.
unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Save before closing?
err.bootmode: The ESP did not enter download mode. Hold BOOT, tap EN/RST, release BOOT and try again. Lower the upload speed if it keeps failing.
err.portbusy: The port is used by another program. Close other IDEs or serial monitors and try again.
err.missinglib: A library header is missing. Install it from the Library Manager (search for its name).
err.notdeclared: A name is used before it is declared: check spelling, the #include, or declare the function above where it is used.
err.toobig: The sketch does not fit. Choose a bigger Partition Scheme in Board options (e.g. Huge APP).
err.semicolon: A semicolon ; is missing on the line before the one reported.
err.nocore: The board package is not installed. Install it from the Boards Manager.
err.noport: The port was not found. Re-plug the board, choose the port again, and check the driver.
err.timeout: The connection timed out. Try a lower baud rate or another USB cable/port.
err.multilib: Two copies of a library exist; the one used is shown in the log. Remove the duplicate if it is wrong.
err.avrsync: The board did not answer. Check the selected board and port, and the driver.
noDevices: No USB-serial board found. Plug in the board with a data cable, then press Scan.
plotHint:
Print numbers from your sketch, e.g. Serial.printf("temp:%.1f,hum:%d
", t, h); — each name becomes a line.
partitionsHint: Read the table from partitions.bin, a merged image or a flash backup.
noTable: No partition table found in this file.
tooManySeries: Only the first 8 series are drawn.
err.otafw: The board accepted the password but could not connect back to this PC: Windows Firewall blocks espota.exe (your network is Public). Easiest fix: add HTTP OTA to your sketch (type http-ota in the editor) — esppro then uploads over HTTP with no firewall change. Or allow espota with the button (needs admin approval).
firewallAsked: Approve the Windows prompt, then upload again.
otaHttpUsed: The board serves /update — sending the firmware over HTTP (no firewall rule needed).
toRecycle: it goes to the Recycle Bin
autoSerialOpt: Open the Serial Monitor automatically after upload
autoConnectOpt: Auto-connect the Serial Monitor when a board is plugged in or a port is selected
exportAllOpt: Export all separate files (bootloader, partitions, app) instead of one complete .bin
cdcHint: This board uses native USB and USB CDC On Boot is disabled, so Serial prints to the UART pins instead of USB.
cdcEnabled: USB CDC On Boot enabled — upload again to apply.
silentHint: No data received. Check the baud rate, or that your sketch prints to Serial.
destructiveGuard: Take a flash backup before continuing?
eraseAllWarn: “Erase whole flash first” is checked — all data on the ESP will be erased.
